t: Visual and text-based lab automation protocol editor in your browser

A visual and text-based engine for writing lab automation protocols, dragging and dropping plates and tubes, setting transfer volumes, previewing movement and validating steps, and exporting data as a file for review or import.
Create and test lab automation steps easily

Easily create lab automation protocols with this visual and text-based editor in your browser. Drag and drop plates and tubes, set transfer volumes like 30 microliters from the reservoir to the well plate, and preview the step sequence on a virtual workspace with timing, collision detection, and alerts for invalid volumes. When finished, export the description as a JSON file for review or import into other environments. Everything runs directly in the page with no external components required.
How do I check for collisions between items?
When you place a new item, the available space is checked automatically. If there is an overlap, the system shows an error and does not add the item.
Can I edit the transfer volume after adding a step?
Yes, you can edit the values in the fields above the list, then click "Add step" to update the list.
What format is the exported file?
The file is exported as JSON containing component and step details, and it can be easily imported again.
Does it support units other than µL?
The app supports µL and mL units, and you can select the unit from the dropdown menu.
Can I run the preview without any visual components?
Yes, even without components, the preview shows the transfer path on the workspace to illustrate timing and order.
